verdict.rationale: Evidence covers WebAuthn/FIDO2 standard support, OS integrations (Windows Hello, Azure AD, OpenSSH), and firmware provisioning via Google's OpenSK repo, but nothing indicates Feitian ships its own official SDK for developers to embed key support into custom desktop/mobile apps. Probe results also confirm no API/docs discoverability artifacts. This is an applicable axis for a hardware key vendor (SDKs are common in this space) but no evidence of one existing.
